local_analysis.note: slope = 1/2 at BOTH singular points (ramification 2). CORRECTS the prior '3/2' paraphrase. Pole order of r at 0 is 3; r ~ 1/(3 t^3) near 0.

kovacic.locator: van der Put & Singer, Galois Theory of Linear Differential Equations, GMW 328, 2003, sec.4.3.4 (Kovacic / order-2 dichotomy) + sec.1.3-1.4 (algebraic Riccati solutions = imprimitivity over a quadratic extension)
kovacic.case2_pullback_cover: x^2 = t (UNIQUE double cover of P^1 branched at exactly {0,inf}; even branch divisor forces this)
kovacic.case2_pullback_only_finite_pole: x=0 (order 4) => rational Riccati forced to a/x^2+b/x+c with a^2=4/3 over Q(sqrt 3); search EXHAUSTIVE
kovacic.case2_note: An SL2-realized (infinite) dihedral group has NO rational Sym^2 invariant (y1*y2 is anti-invariant under the SL2 swap), so a rational-Sym^2-over-C(t) search is NOT a sound Case-2 test; the sound test is reducibility of the pullback over C(sqrt t).
kovacic.verdict: SL_2 (irreducible, not imprimitive, not finite) -- NON-LIOUVILLIAN

normal_form.why_not_classical_confluent: two genuinely irregular singular points (0 and inf); Bessel/Kummer/Whittaker each have exactly one irregular + one regular-singular point. The number/type of irregular points is a gauge+Mobius invariant and is not reduced by the ramified pullback (which fixes {0,inf} and cannot turn a slope>0 point into a regular one).
normal_form.routing: case (b) => stage 2 builds the Hien rapid-decay pairing for rank 2 directly, with the concrete named target = symmetric DCHE.

borel2_hadamard_chain.bessel_kernel: B(z)=I_0(2 sqrt z)=sum z^n/(n!)^2, annihilated by (theta^2 - z) (rank 2)
borel2_hadamard_chain.Phi: Phi(z)=sum Q_n z^n/(n!)^2 = (y (x) B)(z)  [Hadamard / coefficient-wise product]
borel2_hadamard_chain.rank4_derivation: rank-4 L = (rank-2 H2 recurrence) (x) (rank-2 theta^2 - z) via Hadamard product of operators; order <= 2*2 = 4. The leading symbol theta^2 (theta-1)^2 (double root) is the source of the z=0 Jordan [2,2]. The (n!)^2 (double Borel) is what raises the order to 4.

dimension_counts.formula: chi_dR(U,M) = rank*chi(U) - sum_x irr_x(M);  dim H^1_dR = -chi  (H^0=H^2=0, irreducible nonconstant)
dimension_counts.locator: Deligne, Equations differentielles a points singuliers reguliers, LNM 163; Malgrange index theorem; Sabbah, Introduction to Stokes structures, sec.5.
